title: Extremal Perfect Monotone Equilibria in Bayesian Games with Strategic Complementarities
abstract: arXiv:2610.35511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study sharp bounds on equilibrium behavior in Bayesian games when players may make mistakes. Under strategic complementarities, the set of behavioral perfect equilibria has a largest and a smallest element, both in pure strategies. We ask when these bounds are monotone and how they depend on the way mistakes are made. For monotone supermodular games, we consider limits of equilibria under increasing perturbations, in the sense that conditional tremble distributions have full support and increase stochastically with type. We show that the largest and smallest perfect equilibria exist, which are pure and monotone. Under the general perfection notion, the extremal perfect equilibria continue to be monotone in the setting with finite actions. With infinite actions, the extremal perfect equilibria can be nonmonotone, and the set of perfect monotone equilibria can even lack extrema.

translated_title: 具有策略互补性的贝叶斯博弈中的极值完美单调均衡
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当参与者可能犯错时贝叶斯博弈中均衡行为的精确界。在策略互补性条件下，行为完美均衡集合存在最大元和最小元，且两者均为纯策略。我们探讨这些界何时是单调的，以及它们如何依赖于犯错的方式。对于单调超模博弈，我们考虑在递增扰动下均衡的极限，即条件颤抖分布具有完全支撑且随类型随机递增。我们证明了最大和最小完美均衡的存在性，它们是纯策略且单调的。在一般的完美性概念下，在有限行动的设定中，极值完美均衡仍然是单调的。而在无限行动的情况下，极值完美均衡可能是非单调的，完美单调均衡集合甚至可能不存在极值。
tldr: 论文证明了在具有策略互补性的单调超模贝叶斯博弈中，作为递增扰动极限得到的最大和最小完美均衡是纯策略且单调的，且在有限行动下极值完美均衡始终保持单调性，但在无限行动下可能非单调、甚至完美单调均衡集合可能缺乏极值。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that in monotone supermodular Bayesian games with strategic complementarities, the largest and smallest perfect equilibria obtained as limits of increasing perturbations are pure and monotone, that extremal perfect equilibria remain monotone under the general perfection notion with finite actions, but with infinite actions they can be nonmonotone and the set of perfect monotone equilibria may lack extrema.
